answer: Because the timing is logged against the mirror challenge, the dawn audit can replay the ocean history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 276 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 344 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
